jobs.title: ML-Engineer (m/w/d) – Machine Learning für Recyclinganlagen
jobs.description: Digitalisierung ist deine Leidenschaft und du brennst für Nachhaltigkeit? Dann gestalte mit uns die digitale Transformation der Recyclingbranche! Die Eggersmann Gruppe ist ein international tätiger Verbund von Unternehmen mit über 50 Jahren Erfahrung in Umwelttechnologien und mehr als 1.300 Mitarbeitenden weltweit. Als führender Anbieter von Recyclinganlagen und -maschinen treiben wir zukunftsorientierte Lösungen für eine funktionierende Kreislaufwirtschaft voran. Um die Potenziale der Digitalisierung und Automatisierung in der Recyclingbranche voll auszuschöpfen, haben wir in Aachen unseren digitalen Innovations-Hub als Corporate Start-up gegründet. Mit der ESA app, unserer modularen IIoT-Software, optimieren wir den Betrieb von Recyclinganlagen und -maschinen durch Datenanalyse und Machine Learning. Deine Mission: Du machst Machine Learning produktionsreif: Du entwickelst skalierbare Daten- und Modell-Pipelines auf AWS und bringst Machine-Learning-Modelle zuverlässig in den Einsatz. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Anomalieerkennung in Zeitreihendaten von Recyclinganlagen. So trägst du dazu bei, Abweichungen frühzeitig sichtbar zu machen und den Anlagenbetrieb datenbasiert zu verbessern – von der technischen Infrastruktur bis zum laufenden Modellbetrieb. Deine Aufgaben: Du verantwortest die Konzeption, Entwicklung, den Betrieb und die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung skalierbarer Daten- und Modell-Pipelines auf AWS, beispielsweise mit EC2, Lambda, S3 und CloudWatch. Du bringst Machine-Learning-Modelle in den produktiven Einsatz und entwickelst die dafür bestehenden Prozesse weiter – von Bereitstellung und Monitoring über AutoML-gestütztes Retraining bis hin zu CI/CD und Infrastructure as Code (IaC). Du entwirfst Datenmodelle, schreibst effiziente SQL-Abfragen für relationale Datenbanken und verantwortest die zugehörigen Datenbankmanagement-Aufgaben. Du entwickelst, trainierst, validierst und deployst Machine-Learning-Modelle mit Schwerpunkt auf der Anomalieerkennun

jobs.description: Intro For this position we are only looking for candidates located in Greece, Germany or Austria . Nairon GmbH is a Swiss startup building AI voice agents that answer and make phone calls for businesses. Our platform runs real-time conversations over the phone and on the web, connected to our customers' telephony and business tools. We value clear communication, thoughtful engineering, and a collaborative approach to problem-solving. Join us as we continue to develop tools that make a difference. Tasks As a Voice AI Engineer at Nairon GmbH, you will make our agents sound fast, natural and reliable in live calls. Your responsibilities will include: Improving turn-taking: when the agent speaks, waits, yields or gets interrupted, including voice activity and end-of-turn detection. Cutting end-to-end latency across speech recognition, language models and speech synthesis, and making provider failover seamless. Optimising how we use LLMs in conversation: prompting, tool calls, streaming and speculative or parallel requests. Serving our own speech models (STT and TTS) on GPUs, measuring throughput and time to first audio. Fine-tuning speech and language models for our customers' languages and voices. Building evaluation: test calls, benchmarks and quality metrics that tell us when a change really helps. Requirements Experience: A senior or strong mid-level engineer with production experience in real-time audio, conversational AI or ML model serving. Technical Skills: Required: Strong Python , including asyncio and streaming pipelines. Hands-on work with speech (STT, TTS, VAD) and LLM APIs in latency-sensitive systems. Model serving on GPUs, for example with vLLM or similar, and the basics of batching and memory limits. Nice to have: LiveKit Agents , pipecat or WebRTC. Fine-tuning (LoRA or full) of speech or language models. Audio signal processing such as echo cancellation or noise suppression. German, or experience with German-language speech data. Communication: English

jobs.title: Performance Engineer
jobs.description: UK | Full-Time The Mission: Source.dev Our founders spent over a decade at Google shaping the Android operating systems - building and shipping the software that now runs on billions of devices. They didn't just use Android; they led teams responsible for the Android Virtualization Framework , Security , and the Android Runtime (ART) . Through that journey, they saw a quiet but massive crisis: as device software grew in complexity, the tools used to build it remained stuck in the past. Today, a standard Android checkout exceeds 200GB of code, and builds can take hours. This "wait time" is the single biggest tax on innovation. Source.dev was founded to reimagine software development workflows for device makers. We’re building a new generation of software tools that make building complex device software feel as simple as building a webpage - starting with SourceFS. jobs.title: Partenaire commercial indépendant (H/F)
jobs.description: À propos de PropertyOS PropertyOS est une solution SaaS dédiée à la digitalisation de la gestion immobilière. Notre ambition : permettre aux propriétaires et gestionnaires de centraliser leurs biens, leurs locataires, leurs finances, leurs documents et leurs tâches au sein d'une plateforme unique. Nous développons une solution moderne qui répond aux enjeux de simplification, d'organisation et de suivi du patrimoine immobilier. Pour accompagner notre développement commercial, nous souhaitons constituer un premier réseau de partenaires indépendants motivés par la technologie, l'immobilier et l'entrepreneuriat. 🚀 Votre mission En tant que partenaire commercial indépendant, vous contribuez au développement de PropertyOS en identifiant des professionnels susceptibles d'être intéressés par notre solution. Selon le cadre de partenariat convenu, vos missions pourront notamment comprendre : Identifier des prospects : propriétaires, investisseurs immobiliers et professionnels de la gestion locative. Faire connaître PropertyOS : présenter les bénéfices de la solution et partager les supports de communication mis à disposition. Générer des opportunités commerciales : mettre en relation des prospects qualifiés avec PropertyOS. Contribuer au développement du réseau : faire connaître la solution auprès de votre réseau professionnel. Suivre vos opportunités : utiliser les outils mis à disposition pour suivre les prospects que vous avez apportés. Les missions de mise en relation ne comprennent pas la négociation ou la conclusion de contrats au nom de PropertyOS. Toute mission commerciale plus étendue devra faire l'objet d'un cadre contractuel adapté. 💰 Une rémunération liée à vos résultats Nous souhaitons développer un modèle de partenariat fondé sur la performance. La rémunération sera définie contractuellement selon la nature de la mission et les résultats obtenus. Le principe : valoriser concrètement les opportunités commerciales qui contribuent au développement de PropertyOS.

jobs.title: Voice AI Engineer
jobs.description: Intro For this position we are only looking for candidates located in Greece, Germany or Austria . Nairon GmbH is a Swiss startup building AI voice agents that answer and make phone calls for businesses. Our platform runs real-time conversations over the phone and on the web, connected to our customers' telephony and business tools. We value clear communication, thoughtful engineering, and a collaborative approach to problem-solving. Join us as we continue to develop tools that make a difference. Tasks As a Voice AI Engineer at Nairon GmbH, you will make our agents sound fast, natural and reliable in live calls. Your responsibilities will include: Improving turn-taking: when the agent speaks, waits, yields or gets interrupted, including voice activity and end-of-turn detection. Cutting end-to-end latency across speech recognition, language models and speech synthesis, and making provider failover seamless. Optimising how we use LLMs in conversation: prompting, tool calls, streaming and speculative or parallel requests. Serving our own speech models (STT and TTS) on GPUs, measuring throughput and time to first audio. Fine-tuning speech and language models for our customers' languages and voices. Building evaluation: test calls, benchmarks and quality metrics that tell us when a change really helps. You will inherit an established team of senior specialists, and your mandate is to make them better: sharper technical execution, deeper coverage across both regions, and a higher bar for how Kasten is positioned and proven. jobs.title: (Senior) Data Engineer - Tracking Infrastructure (m/f/d)
jobs.description: At Statista , we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions. Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees. We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team. Are you ready to join us? About the role Join a growing data team and take ownership of our tracking data infrastructure, which captures millions of user events across our web platform every day. You will focus on operating, improving, and scaling existing data systems, ensuring data is reliable, cost-efficient, and accessible for analytics teams. This is a hands-on role with strong ownership and visibility across engineering and analytics. What you’ll do Own and manage tracking data pipelines and infrastructure (event data, web tracking) Ensure data quality, governance, and cost control (e.g. retention, storage optimization) Build and optimize ELT pipelines using Python and SQL Improve data ingestion and orchestration (Airflow, Prefect, APIs, S3, Iceberg, databases) Support the shift toward streaming and modern analytics use cases Collaborate with engineering teams (data producers) and analytics teams (data consumers) Enable internal users by making data reliable, well-documented, and easy to use Your profile Experience in data engineering within cloud environments (AWS preferred) Strong skills in Python and SQL Hands-on experience with data pipelines, orchestration

jobs.title: Engineering Lead
jobs.description: The Role BJAK builds technology products used by millions of users across Southeast Asia. As our products and systems scale, we need technical leaders who can solve difficult engineering problems and raise the engineering bar around them. The Engineering Lead owns technical direction and execution for major products and systems . This is a hands-on role - you will design systems, write code, and drive critical engineering work from idea to production. What You'll Own Owning technical design and execution for major products, systems and engineering initiatives. Designing scalable, reliable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure. Building alongside the team through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving. Driving architecture decisions and trade-offs across speed, scalability, reliability, cost and maintainability. Turning ambiguous product problems into clear technical solutions and execution plans. Raising engineering quality through stronger system design, testing, security, observability and development practices. Leading technically critical initiatives and mentoring engineers across teams. What We're Looking For 7+ years of software engineering experience building and shipping production systems. Deep expertise in backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure. Strong system design and architecture skills for complex or high-scale systems. Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on. Track record of technically leading major engineering projects from design through production. Ability to make sound technical trade-offs, influence engineers and solve complex production problems. Nice to have Experience scaling engineering teams, systems or development practices through significant growth. Experience operating across multiple products, markets or countries. Location This is a remote role . We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zone

jobs.description: The Role BJAK builds technology products used by millions of users across Southeast Asia. As our products and systems scale, we need technical leaders who can solve difficult engineering problems and raise the engineering bar around them. The Principal Software Engineer owns technical direction and execution for major products and systems . This is a hands-on role - you will design systems, write code, and drive critical engineering work from idea to production. Driving architecture decisions and trade-offs across speed, scalability, reliability, cost and maintainability. Turning ambiguous product problems into clear technical solutions and execution plans. Raising engineering quality through stronger system design, testing, security, observability and development practices. Leading technically critical initiatives and mentoring engineers across teams. What We're Looking For 7+ years of software engineering experience building and shipping production systems. Deep expertise in backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure. Strong system design and architecture skills for complex or high-scale systems. Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on. Track record of technically leading major engineering projects from design through production. Ability to make sound technical trade-offs, influence engineers and solve complex production problems. Nice to have Experience scaling engineering teams, systems or development practices through significant growth. Experience operating across multiple products, markets or countries. jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer
jobs.description: Our mission We re making Africa the first cashless continent. In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That s for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash. We re solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don t always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast. Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that s where you come in... How you ll help us achieve it We’re looking for an experienced security engineer who’s independent, excited about getting things done, and ready to hit the ground running. You ll primarily be responsible for our application security, working with our product teams to work on new systems to enhance our security posture. Our customers trust us with their money, and you’ll be at the forefront of making sure we retain that trust! This broadly scoped role will allow you to get your hands on many different types of security projects, from direct application security to helping our infrastructure team think about security for our databases.  As we integrate AI-powered agents into our engineering and operations workflows, you ll help define and enforce the guardrails around how we use them safely. jobs.title: AI Solutions Architect- Pre-sales (UK)
jobs.description: AI Solutions Architect- Pre-sales (UK) We are seeking a motivated AI Architect - Pre-sales to join our sales team, specializing in the AI security space. As an AI Architect- Pre-sales, you will be instrumental in driving the adoption of our innovative AI security solutions, working closely with our sales representatives and prospective clients to understand their security needs, demonstrate the capabilities of our products, and architect tailored solutions that address their unique requirements. Your technical expertise, combined with strong communication and interpersonal skills, will be essential in building and maintaining relationships with clients and effectively articulating the value proposition of our AI security offerings. WHO WE ARE: HiddenLayer protects the world’s most valuable technologies from adversarial AI attacks. We were founded by AI professionals and security specialists with first-hand experience of how insidious adversarial AI attacks can be to detect and defend against. Determined to prove that these attacks were preventable, the team developed a unique, patent-pending, productized solution to support organizations in accelerating their adoption of AI securely.  Our dedication to innovation has been recognized by prestigious awards such as RSA s Innovation Sandbox Winner, CB Insights AI 100, CyberTech 100, and SC s Most Promising Early-Stage Start-up. WHAT YOU LL DO: Technical Consultation: Collaborate with the sales team to engage with clients and prospects, conducting technical discussions to understand their security challenges, objectives, and infrastructure requirements. Product Demonstrations: Conduct product demonstrations and presentations, showcasing the features, functionalities, and benefits of our AI security solutions to prospective clients. Solution Design: Architect customized security solutions tailored to client needs, leveraging your understanding of cybersecurity principles, AI technologies, and industry best practices.

jobs.description: Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands. About the Role Veeam Kasten for Kubernetes is Veeam s Kubernetes-native data protection platform, purpose-built for modern cloud-native applications and AI-driven workloads. As enterprises accelerate Kubernetes adoption through container-based application modernization and modern virtualization, Kasten is positioned to be the data resilience standard for cloud-native infrastructure. Reporting to the leader of Worldwide Kasten Solution Sales, you will partner with regional Kasten and field sales leadership to build territory strategy, raise technical win rates, and scale Kasten expertise across the broader Veeam field organization. You will also own the field-to-product feedback loop, working directly with Kasten Product Management and engineering to represent customer requirements. While Kasten is the primary focus, this leader will also support Veeam Data Platform opportunities where Kubernetes and virtualization workloads converge. This is a hands-on leadership role. You will inherit an established team of senior specialists, and your mandate is to make them better: sharper technical execution, deeper coverage across both regions, and a higher bar for how Kasten is positioned and proven. jobs.title: Responsable Accompagnement Clients - Transition énergétique des bâtiments
jobs.description: Chez Lowit, nous avons une ambition : accélérer et massifier la transition énergétique des bâtiments tertiaires. Face à la hausse des coûts de l'énergie, aux enjeux climatiques et aux évolutions réglementaires, les gestionnaires de patrimoine ont besoin d'outils fiables, mais aussi d'un accompagnement de qualité pour passer à l'action. C'est pourquoi nous avons développé une plateforme SaaS qui permet de créer le jumeau numérique des bâtiments, de piloter les consommations énergétiques et de construire des trajectoires d'investissement réalistes, chiffrées et adaptées aux enjeux de chaque organisation. Aujourd'hui, nous accompagnons plusieurs centaines de collectivités et d'entreprises partout en France dans leurs projets de transition énergétique. PME lyonnaise en forte croissance, nous recherchons des collaborateurs qui souhaitent avoir un impact concret, prendre des responsabilités et contribuer à une aventure collective porteuse de sens. Vos missions Chez Lowit, nous accompagnons chaque jour des collectivités, des entreprises et des établissements publics dans la gestion et la transition énergétique de leur patrimoine immobilier. Notre plateforme leur permet de mieux connaître leurs bâtiments, de piloter leurs consommations, d'anticiper les obligations réglementaires et de construire des trajectoires d'investissement cohérentes. Parce qu'une plateforme ne crée de valeur que lorsqu'elle est pleinement appropriée par ses utilisateurs, nous accordons une place essentielle à l'accompagnement de nos clients. C'est précisément la mission de notre équipe Accompagnement Clients. Pour accompagner notre croissance, nous recherchons aujourd'hui un(e) Responsable Accompagnement Clients . Vous deviendrez l'interlocuteur privilégié d'un portefeuille de collectivités, d'entreprises et d'établissements publics. Votre mission sera de construire une relation de confiance durable avec vos clients, de comprendre leurs enjeux et de les accompagner dans l'utilisation de nos solutions
